narrative.details: You have accomplished the impossible. The brood mother of the Black Dragonflight lies dead at your feet. Take her head and present it to your Warchief.
narrative.objectives: Take the Head of Onyxia to Thrall in Orgrimmar.
narrative.offerRewardText: This is a great victory for the Horde, adventurer. So many times you have honored your Warchief. It is time for the Warchief to honor you.
narrative.requestItemsText: <Thrall's stoic demeanor changes for a split second when he sees the enormous head of Onyxia. The mighty Doomhammer was nearly unsheathed.>
